scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')) fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')) fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
